control.finish_rule: All joints formed and rear window exhausted; internal modules 2..18 on inferred target, internal source contacts absent over 0.4s, >=1.5 wraps and >=180deg distributed target contact span, persistent for 0.6s. Smooth 2s transition to whole-body A-D; current torsion sign at ends.
control.controller_inputs: encoder angles, own commands, history; exact nominal dynamics, right-angle/comparable-radius and gravity-orientation priors; no true axes/contact labels/floating pose

control.handoff_guard: Existing source/junction clearance plus all module centres in target radial band, >=1.5 wraps, both body halves supported for 0.6s before removing progress limits

unchanged_acceptance.complete: existing traveling_winding_audit physical all-body crossing plus one rolling cycle and one-link advance
